name: Acrid Barrage
text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect Each enemy in your aura takes ternarygte(@actor.level, 18, 7, ternarygte(@actor.level, 15, 6, 5))d6 acid,2d6 persistent,acid damage with a basic Reflex save save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. The initial damage increases to 6d6 at 15th level and 7d6 at 18th level.
